title: Remove launch preflight startup banner and queue-scan launch block
summary: Remove the global Launch backend-preflight startup banner and stop treating transient queue source-scan status as the authority for normal Run Once when a valid dry-run queue snapshot exists.
reason: The global red preflight banner is unwanted and a concurrent source scan can overwrite transient scan status even though the backend already has a valid dry-run snapshot and runtime fingerprint verification for the requested queue.
behavior_before: Blocked pipeline preflight rows could insert an assertive red banner beneath the top bar. Normal Run Once was rejected while a queue source scan was active, incomplete, inventory-only, or carried a request ID different from the otherwise valid dry-run snapshot.
behavior_after: No shipped WebView source can create or style the global Launch preflight banner. Normal Run Once uses the validated dry-run queue snapshot as launch authority; a source scan still in starting/inventory work atomically defers its curation instead of blocking launch, while a scan that already claimed its queue dry-run continues to block duplicate pipeline work. Transient scan completion, inventory mode, and request identity do not invalidate the otherwise valid snapshot, and all durable snapshot, membership, fingerprint, pending-publish, active-work, and duplicate-launch guards remain.
tests_added: Changed WebView tests to prove blocked preflight evidence cannot create a global startup banner and shipped frontend source contains none of the removed banner tokens.
Changed backend launch-policy tests to prove a valid dry-run snapshot remains launchable while queue source-scan status is transient or a scan is active.
